problem: Some ordinary frame heads still miss teacherKL0.005 after fixed-capacity optimization. Determine whether identical actual network inputs have inconsistent pseudo-targets before increasing capacity.
theory: For any deterministic predictor, an exact input class has one probability. Its weighted Bernoulli-CE optimum is the weighted mean teacher target; the weighted within-class Bernoulli KL is a representational lower bound.
interpretation: This does not establish semantic correctness, the total optimal loss of a finite neural head, or HOTA gains. A zero equality-class floor does not prove all teacher loss is achievable by the current architecture.
decision: If floor exceeds0.005, do not call that head fully fitted or lower the threshold. Otherwise investigate capacity/optimization using only teacher losses. No quality model changes in this audit.
data: Only unsuccessful causal KITTI prefixes of the completed fit supplement; existing pseudo-targets, coarse inputs and normalization checkpoints; no quality predictions or manual targetGT.
